These are single-attempt guesses. The page names no verbs apart from a few (`doc`, `open`, `count`, `eq`, `gt`, `add`, `type`), so most verb names below (`filter`, `groupBy`, `sort`, `lower`, `split`, and so on) are assumptions that I couldn't check.

K1: K1: `["Apple" "banana" "APPLE" "Cherry" "banana" "date" "Date" "elderberry"] * lower | distinct | count`
K2: K2: `filter (/status | eq "paid") | groupBy /customer | mapVals (* (/total | default 0) | sum)`
K3: K3: `lines * (split " " | /1) | countBy`
K4: K4: `[/dependencies /devDependencies] * keys | flat | distinct | filter (. | startsWith "^") | sort`
K5: K5: `filter (/state | eq "open") | sortBy [{:k (/comments | default 0) :desc true} {:k /id}] | take 3 * /id`
K6: K6: `lines | drop 1 * split "," | filter ((/2 | lower | eq "de") | and (/1 | ne "")) * (/1 | toNumber) | avg | round 1`
K7: K7: `/services | entries | filter ((/1/enabled | eq true) | and (/1/port | isNumber)) | sortBy /1/port * (/0 | add ":" | add (/1/port | str))`
K8: K8: `/results | filter ((/email | ne null) | and (/email | split "@" | /1 | lower | eq "example.com") | and (/user/name/last | ne null)) * (/user/name/last | add ", " | add /user/name/first)`
K9: K9: `filter ((/user | ne null) | and (/action | lower | eq "login")) * (/user | lower) | distinct | sort`
K10: K10: `filter (/salary | ne null) | groupBy /dept | mapVals (* /salary | avg | round 2)`
K11: K11: `* (/tags | default "" | split "," * trim | * lower | filter (. | ne "")) | flat | countBy | entries | sortBy [{:k /1 :desc true} {:k /0}] | take 3 * /0`
K12: K12: `lines * trim | filter ((. | ne "") | and (. | startsWith "#" | not)) * (split "|" | (/1 | toNumber | mul (/2 | toNumber))) | sum | round 2`
K13: K13: `/services | filter (/env | lower | eq "prod") | all ((/replicas | default 1) | gte 2)`
K14: K14: `* {:id /id :itemCount (/items | default [] * /qty | sum)} | filter (/itemCount | gt 0) | sortBy [{:k /itemCount :desc true} {:k /id}] | take 3`
